results.title: Building on Abacum Intelligence, Abacum Launches Modeler and Brings Agentic Modeling to Every Finance Team
results.content: NEW YORK and BARCELONA, Spain, Oct. 13, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Abacum, the AI-native FP&A platform, today launched Modeler, an AI agent that brings Agentic Modeling to finance teams. Starting from natural language prompts or existing spreadsheets, Modeler transforms initial inputs into live, fully functional business models instantly ready for execution. [...] Abacum is the AI-native business planning platform. Built first for finance and extended to every department, Abacum holds a company's data, business logic and context in one governed layer, where AI agents and teams plan the business together. Agents own the recurring workflows; people own the judgment. More than 500 customers in over 40 countries run their planning on Abacum, including DISH, ThoughtSpot, Strava, Acorns and Replit. Founded in 2020 and headquartered in New York, with offices in [...] with offices in Toronto, Barcelona, Buenos Aires and the UK, Abacum is backed by more than $100 million from investors including Scale Venture Partners, Atomico and Y Combinator.
